data.title: Exclusive-Chery's robot unit eyes IPO, targets overseas market for police robots
data.description: The robotics division of China's largest auto exporter Chery Automobile is gearing up for an IPO to fund future growth and investments, its chief said on Wednesday, as competition intensifies in the country's fast-growing humanoid robot ‌sector.  AiMOGA Robotics is in talks over potential listing venues and expects to sharply increase humanoid robot deliveries next year as it seeks to ‌join the ranks of global robotics heavyweights, Zhang Guibing, head of the business and president of Chery International, told Reuters on the sidelines of the World Robot Conference in Beijing.
data.keywords: humanoid robot, Zhang Guibing, Chery Automobile, humanoid robotics, China, technology investments, Chery International
